lines.en: I got a headache like a machete blow, the worst of my life. It'll pass soon. And how are you?

lines.text: Los ojos y la piel los tengo amarillos como un limón, mi comadre me lo notó.
lines.en: My eyes and skin are yellow like a lemon, my comadre noticed.

lines.text: Me mareé en el baño y me caí de nalgas. Perdí el conocimiento un ratico.

lines.text: Boto sangre por la nariz y no para, y las encías también, desde la quimio nueva.
lines.en: My nose is bleeding and won't stop, and my gums too, since the new chemo.

lines.text: Me falta el aire hasta pa' ir a la cocina. Antes yo caminaba la cuadra entera.
lines.en: I run out of air even to go to the kitchen. I used to walk the whole block.

lines.text: Tengo la cara como torcida de un lado y se me traba la lengua. Será que dormí mal.
lines.en: My face feels twisted on one side and my tongue gets stuck. Maybe I slept badly.

lines.text: Las heces me salen negras como alquitrán y ando con flojera y mareada.
lines.en: My stool comes out black like tar and I feel weak and dizzy.

lines.text: El catéter donde me ponen la quimio está rojo, caliente y supurando, y tengo 38 y medio.
lines.en: The catheter where they give me chemo is red, hot and oozing, and I have 38.5 (101.3 F).

lines.text: Me dio un dolor tremendo en la espalda de repente, no siento bien los pies y no puedo orinar.
lines.en: I suddenly got a tremendous back pain, I can't feel my feet properly and I can't urinate.

lines.text: Tengo la barriga durísima e hinchada y un dolor que no me deja ni enderezar.
lines.en: My belly is rock hard and swollen and the pain won't even let me straighten up.

lines.text: Se me nubló la vista de un ojo de repente, como una cortina que cayó.
lines.en: The vision in one eye suddenly clouded over, like a curtain dropped.

lines.text: Tosí y salió sangre, poquito, será de la garganta irritada.
lines.en: I coughed and blood came out, a little, probably from my irritated throat.

lines.text: El brazo del lado de la mastectomía se me puso gordo y morado, duele, y ahora me falta el aire.
lines.en: The arm on my mastectomy side got fat and purple, it hurts, and now I'm short of breath.

lines.text: A veces pienso que mejor me muero y dejo de dar lata.
lines.en: Sometimes I think it'd be better if I died and stopped being a bother.

lines.text: Ya le regalé el anillo de mi mamá a mi sobrina y el carro a mi hijo. Pa' qué esperar.
lines.en: I already gave my mother's ring to my niece and the car to my son. Why wait.

lines.text: Si me pasa algo, las llaves de la caja fuerte están debajo del colchón. Que lo sepan.
lines.en: If something happens to me, the safe keys are under the mattress. Let them know.

lines.text: He guardado las pastillas del dolor, ya tengo como cincuenta. Las cuento todas las noches.
lines.en: I've been saving my pain pills, I have about fifty. I count them every night.

lines.text: Mi cuñado dejó una pistola en la casa y yo me la paso mirándola.
lines.en: My brother-in-law left a pistol at the house and I keep staring at it.

lines.text: Ya sé cómo y cuándo. No se preocupe por mí.
lines.en: I already know how and when. Don't worry about me.

lines.text: Soy una carga pa' mis hijos. Estarían mejor sin mí y sin mis deudas.
lines.en: I'm a burden to my kids. They'd be better off without me and my debts.

lines.text: Hoy amanecí tranquila, en paz. Ya tomé mi decisión y todo está arreglado.
lines.en: Today I woke up calm, at peace. I made my decision and everything is arranged.

lines.text: Ya no más quimio. ¿Pa' qué, pa' alargar el sufrimiento? Cancele las citas.
lines.en: No more chemo. What for, to prolong the suffering? Cancel the appointments.

lines.text: Me acuesto pidiéndole a Dios que no me despierte.
lines.en: I go to bed asking God not to wake me up.

lines.text: Ayer me paré un rato en lo alto del puente del Rickenbacker mirando el agua.
lines.en: Yesterday I stood a while at the top of the Rickenbacker bridge looking at the water.

lines.text: Dígale a mis hijos que los quise mucho, por si acaso no los veo.
lines.en: Tell my kids I loved them very much, in case I don't see them.

lines.text: Escribí cartas pa' todo el mundo y ya escogí la funeraria.
lines.en: I wrote letters for everyone and already chose the funeral home.

lines.text: No me voy a hacer nada, pero si me atropellara un carro, qué descanso.
lines.en: I'm not going to do anything to myself, but if a car ran me over, what a relief.

lines.text: Compré una soga en la ferretería, no sé pa' qué. La tengo en el baúl del carro.
lines.en: I bought a rope at the hardware store, I don't know what for. It's in the trunk of the car.

lines.text: Estoy cerrando cuentas: cancelé el teléfono, regalé el perro. Limpiando la casa.
lines.en: I'm closing accounts: cancelled the phone, gave away the dog. Cleaning house.

lines.text: Oiga, si uno se toma todas las pastillas de dormir juntas, ¿qué pasa? Es pa' una amiga.
lines.en: Hey, if someone takes all their sleeping pills at once, what happens? It's for a friend.

lines.text: El cáncer me quitó todo. Estoy cansada de verdad, mija. Ya quiero terminar.
lines.en: Cancer took everything from me. I'm truly tired, mija. I want to be done.

lines.text: No hay nada en la nevera desde el domingo. Estoy tomando agua con azúcar.
lines.en: There's nothing in the fridge since Sunday. I'm drinking sugar water.

lines.text: Me pusieron el aviso de desalojo en la puerta, el viernes vienen y no tengo adónde ir.
lines.en: They put an eviction notice on my door, they come Friday and I have nowhere to go.

lines.text: Esta noche duermo en el carro otra vez. Se me acabó el dinero del motel.
lines.en: Tonight I sleep in the car again. The motel money ran out.

lines.text: Me cortaron la luz en Hialeah y tengo la máquina de oxígeno. La comida se me está dañando.
lines.en: They cut my power in Hialeah and I have the oxygen machine. My food is spoiling.

lines.text: En la farmacia me cobran cuatrocientos por la pastilla y no la recogí. Llevo una semana sin ella.
lines.en: The pharmacy charges four hundred for the pill and I didn't pick it up. A week without it.

lines.text: Me parto las pastillas por la mitad pa' que me duren hasta fin de mes.
lines.en: I split my pills in half so they last until the end of the month.

lines.text: Mi marido me quitó el celular y las llaves, se pone bravo si llamo a alguien. Estoy hablando del teléfono de la vecina.
lines.en: My husband took my cell and keys, he gets angry if I call anyone. I'm calling from the neighbor's phone.

lines.text: Anoche me volvió a pegar. Tengo miedo de volver a la casa hoy.
lines.en: Last night he hit me again. I'm afraid to go back home today.

lines.text: Mañana tengo radiación y no tengo cómo llegar. El que me llevaba no puede y no tengo ni pa' la guagua.
lines.en: Tomorrow I have radiation and no way to get there. The person who drove me can't and I don't even have bus fare.

lines.text: El seguro me negó la infusión, piden tres mil por adelantado. No voy el jueves.
lines.en: Insurance denied the infusion, they want three thousand up front. I'm not going Thursday.

lines.text: Llevamos una semana sin agua, acarreamos cubetas del vecino.
lines.en: We've been a week without water, we haul buckets from the neighbor.

lines.text: Mi hija dice que me tengo que ir esta noche, que va a cambiar la cerradura.
lines.en: My daughter says I have to leave tonight, that she's changing the lock.

lines.text: Tengo a mis nietos aquí y solo hay arroz, y mañana ya no hay ni arroz.
lines.en: I have my grandchildren here and there's only rice, and tomorrow there's not even rice.

lines.text: Desde las cinco de la mañana en la cola del banco de comida y se acabó antes de mi turno.
lines.en: Since five in the morning in the food bank line and it ran out before my turn.

lines.text: Tengo hasta el mediodía pa' salir del hotel y no tengo a dónde ir.
lines.en: I have until noon to leave the hotel and nowhere to go.

lines.text: Mi hijo maneja mi dinero y no me deja ir a la cita. Dice que estoy bien y no me da ni pa' la guagua.
lines.en: My son handles my money and won't let me go to the appointment. He says I'm fine and won't even give me bus fare.

lines.text: Se me venció el Medicaid y en la farmacia no me dieron la morfina. Ando con un dolor horrible.
lines.en: My Medicaid expired and the pharmacy wouldn't give me the morphine. I'm in terrible pain.

lines.text: El refugio está lleno hasta la semana que viene, estoy durmiendo en un banco del parque.
lines.en: The shelter is full until next week, I'm sleeping on a park bench.

lines.text: Tuve fiebre el sábado pero fui a urgencias, me dieron antibiótico y ya se me quitó hace dos días. Ando bien.
lines.en: I had a fever Saturday but went to urgent care, they gave me antibiotics and it went away two days ago. I'm fine.

lines.text: Las náuseas después de la quimio ahí están, pero con el Zofran se me controlan, igual que siempre.
lines.en: The nausea after chemo is there but Zofran controls it, same as always.

lines.text: Mi esposo tiene gripe, lleva toda la semana tosiendo, pero ya lo vio el médico y está con medicina.
lines.en: My husband has the flu, coughing all week, but the doctor saw him and he's on medicine.

lines.text: Estoy bien cansada últimamente, fue una semana larga. Nada nuevo.
lines.en: I've been really tired lately, it was a long week. Nothing new.

lines.text: Este cáncer me está matando, jaja, pero lo peor es el parqueo del hospital.
lines.en: This cancer is killing me, haha, but the worst is the hospital parking.

lines.text: Con este calor de Miami me voy a morir, ay, qué sofoco.
lines.en: In this Miami heat I'm going to die, oh, what suffocation.

lines.text: Todo está carísimo, la compra subió como cuarenta dólares, pero nos las arreglamos.
lines.en: Everything is so expensive, groceries went up about forty dollars, but we manage.

lines.text: En 2019 pasé un momento muy oscuro, pero hice terapia y llevo años bien.
lines.en: In 2019 I went through a very dark time, but I did therapy and have been well for years.

lines.text: En mi cumpleaños le di a mi nieta la receta del flan de mi abuela. Lloró de la emoción.
lines.en: On my birthday I gave my granddaughter my grandmother's flan recipe. She cried with emotion.

lines.text: La abogada dijo que a mi edad todos deben tener testamento, y lo hicimos. Estoy contenta, el doctor dice que los resultados salieron limpios.
lines.en: The lawyer said everyone my age should have a will and we did it. I'm happy, the doctor says my results came out clean.

lines.text: Se me está cayendo el pelo a puñados, como me advirtieron. Me compré una peluca bien linda.
lines.en: My hair is falling out in handfuls, as they warned. I bought a really cute wig.

lines.text: Lloré viendo una novela, extraño a mi mamá, hoy es su aniversario. Pero estoy bien.
lines.en: I cried watching a soap opera, I miss my mother, today is her anniversary. But I'm okay.

lines.text: Me duele la rodilla desde que camino más. Me puse hielo y ya está mejor.
lines.en: My knee hurts since I walk more. I put ice on it and it's better.

lines.text: A mi hermana le dio dolor de pecho la semana pasada, le pusieron un stent y está en casa descansando.
lines.en: My sister had chest pain last week, they put in a stent and she's resting at home.

lines.text: El hormigueo en los dedos de los pies por la quimio es igual que siempre, la doctora lo sabe.
lines.en: The tingling in my toes from chemo is the same as always, the doctor knows.

lines.text: Me muero por probar ese restaurante nuevo de croquetas en la Ocho.
lines.en: I'm dying to try that new croquette place on Eighth Street.

lines.text: Dormí como un tronco anoche, el mejor sueño en un mes.
lines.en: I slept like a log last night, the best sleep in a month.

lines.text: La renta vence el viernes y ya la tengo. Solo es un mes apretado.
lines.en: Rent is due Friday and I have it. Just a tight month.

lines.text: Ayer me salió un poquito de sangre de la nariz por el aire seco, una vez, paró enseguida y hoy la enfermera me revisó y dijo que bien.
lines.en: Yesterday a little blood came from my nose from the dry air, once, it stopped right away and today the nurse checked and said fine.

lines.text: Regalé un montón de ropa vieja a la iglesia. Limpieza de primavera, el clóset estaba reventando.
lines.en: I gave a bunch of old clothes to the church. Spring cleaning, the closet was bursting.

lines.text: Cuando me lo encontraron pensé en acabar con todo un momento. Eso pasó hace mucho. Me alegra estar aquí.
lines.en: When they found it I thought about ending it all for a moment. That was long ago. I'm glad to be here.

lines.text: Me llamaron para recordarme la cita de mañana. Mi vecina me lleva, todo listo.
lines.en: They called to remind me of tomorrow's appointment. My neighbor is driving me, all set.

lines.text: Estoy tan aburrida que me muero, jaja. No hay nada en la tele.
lines.en: I'm so bored I'm dying, haha. Nothing on TV.

lines.text: Estuve estreñida dos días pero tomé el laxante y funcionó.
lines.en: I was constipated two days but took the laxative and it worked.

lines.text: Depi yè swa m ap tranble, dan m ap frape, men m pran yon ti te cho. M pa vle deranje.
lines.en: Since last night I'm shaking, my teeth chatter, but I took a little hot tea. I don't want to bother.

lines.text: Gen yon bagay ki peze sou pwatrin mwen e li desann nan bra gòch mwen. M panse se gaz.
lines.en: Something is pressing on my chest and it goes down my left arm. I think it's gas.

lines.text: Janm dwat mwen anfle, li cho epi li di, depi m soti nan vwayaj machin lan.
lines.en: My right leg is swollen, hot and hard, since I got back from the car trip.

lines.text: De jou m pa ka kenbe menm dlo, tout bagay m bwè m vomi l.
lines.en: For two days I can't keep even water, everything I drink I throw up.

lines.text: Madanm mwen di m t ap pale ankourin maten an, m pa chonje anyen.
lines.en: My wife says I was talking nonsense this morning, I don't remember anything.

lines.text: Mwen gen pi gwo tèt fè mal nan lavi m, li vin tankou kou baton. M ap pran yon Tylenol, e ou menm ki jan ou ye?
lines.en: I have the worst headache of my life, it came like a blow of a stick. I'm taking a Tylenol, and how are you?

lines.text: Je m ak po m vin jòn tankou sitwon, kòmè m remake sa.
lines.en: My eyes and skin turned yellow like a lemon, my kòmè noticed.

lines.text: Mwen tonbe nan twalèt la, m pèdi konnesans yon ti moman. Men m byen kounye a.
lines.en: I fell in the bathroom, I lost consciousness for a moment. But I'm fine now.

lines.text: Nen m ap senyen e li pa vle sispann, jansiv mwen yo tou, depi nouvo chimyo a.
lines.en: My nose is bleeding and won't stop, my gums too, since the new chemo.

lines.text: Souf mwen kout menm pou m al nan kwizin nan. Avan m te mache tout blòk la.
lines.en: I'm out of breath even to go to the kitchen. Before, I walked the whole block.

lines.text: Fas mwen tòde yon bò, lang mwen kwoke. Kèk fwa se mal dòmi.
lines.en: My face is twisted on one side, my tongue is stuck. Maybe it's bad sleep.

lines.text: Poupou m nwa kòm goudwon e tèt mwen ap vire lè m leve.
lines.en: My stool is black like tar and I get dizzy when I stand up.

lines.text: Kote yo mete pòt la, li wouj, li cho, epi gen move dlo k ap soti. M gen lafyèv 38.5.
lines.en: Where they put the port it's red, hot and there's bad fluid coming out. I have a 38.5 fever.

lines.text: Gen yon doulè nan do m ki vin sibitman, e pye m angoudi, m pa ka pipi byen.
lines.en: A pain came suddenly in my back, my feet are numb, I can't pee right.

lines.text: Vant mwen anfle di tankou tanbou, doulè a pa kite m dwat.
lines.en: My belly is swollen hard like a drum, the pain won't let me stand straight.

lines.text: Je dwat mwen fè nwa sibitman, tankou yon rido ki tonbe.
lines.en: My right eye suddenly went dark, like a curtain fell.

lines.text: M touse e gen yon ti kras san ladan l. Se gòj mwen ki irite, mwen kwè.
lines.en: I coughed and there's a little blood in it. It's my irritated throat, I think.

lines.text: Bra a bò kote operasyon an anfle, li vin mòv, li fè mal, epi kounye a m manke souf.
lines.en: The arm on the surgery side swelled, turned purple, hurts, and now I'm short of breath.

lines.text: Pafwa m panse li t ap pi bon si m pa t la ankò.
lines.en: Sometimes I think it would be better if I wasn't here anymore.

lines.text: Mwen bay pitit fi m bag manman m nan ak machin lan bay pitit gason m. Poukisa m ta tann?
lines.en: I gave my daughter my mother's ring and the car to my son. Why would I wait?

lines.text: Si gen yon bagay ki rive m, kle kòfrefò a anba matla a. Pou yo konnen.
lines.en: If something happens to me, the safe key is under the mattress. So they know.

lines.text: M ap sere grenn doulè yo. M gen anviwon senkant kounye a, m konte yo chak swa.
lines.en: I'm saving the pain pills. I have about fifty now, I count them every night.

lines.text: Frè m kite yon revolvè lakay mwen e m ap gade l anpil.
lines.en: My brother left a revolver at my house and I look at it a lot.

lines.text: M konnen kijan e m konnen kilè. Pa enkyete w pou mwen.
lines.en: I know how and I know when. Don't worry about me.

lines.text: M se yon chay pou pitit mwen yo. Yo t ap pi byen san mwen.
lines.en: I'm a burden to my children. They'd be better off without me.

lines.text: Jodi a m santi m anpè anpil. M deside, tout bagay rele.
lines.en: Today I feel very much at peace. I decided, everything is settled.

lines.text: M fini ak chimyo a. Anile randevou yo. Pou kisa, pou m soufri plis?
lines.en: I'm finished with chemo. Cancel the appointments. For what, to suffer more?

lines.text: Chak swa m kouche m mande Bondye pou m pa leve.
lines.en: Every night I lie down and ask God that I not wake up.

lines.text: Yè m te kanpe anwo pon an yon bon moman ap gade dlo a.
lines.en: Yesterday I stood on top of the bridge a good while watching the water.

lines.text: Di pitit mwen yo m renmen yo anpil, nan ka m pa wè yo ankò.
lines.en: Tell my children I love them a lot, in case I don't see them again.

lines.text: M ekri lèt pou tout moun e m chwazi fineray la deja.
lines.en: I wrote letters for everyone and I already chose the funeral.

lines.text: M p ap fè anyen sou tèt mwen, men si yon machin frape m, m p ap vire kò m.
lines.en: I won't do anything to myself, but if a car hits me, I won't move away.

lines.text: M achte yon kòd nan Home Depot, m pa konn pou kisa. Li nan kòf machin lan.
lines.en: I bought a rope at Home Depot, I don't know what for. It's in the car trunk.

lines.text: M ap fèmen kont mwen yo, m bay chen an, m koupe telefòn lan. M ap netwaye kay la.
lines.en: I'm closing my accounts, I gave away the dog, cut the phone. I'm cleaning up the house.

lines.text: Di m, si yon moun pran tout grenn dòmi yo ansanm, kisa k ap pase? Se pou yon zanmi.
lines.en: Tell me, if someone takes all the sleeping pills together, what happens? It's for a friend.

lines.text: Kansè a pran tout bagay. M bouke vre, m pare pou fini.
lines.en: Cancer took everything. I'm truly tired, I'm ready to finish.

lines.text: Pa gen anyen nan frijidè a depi dimanch. M ap bwè dlo ak sik.
lines.en: There's nothing in the fridge since Sunday. I'm drinking water with sugar.

lines.text: Mèt kay la kole avi a sou pòt la, chèf la ap vini vandredi. M pa gen kote pou m ale.
lines.en: The landlord stuck the notice on the door, the sheriff comes Friday. I have nowhere to go.

lines.text: Aswè a m nan machin mwen ankò, lajan motèl la fini.
lines.en: Tonight I'm in my car again, the motel money is finished.

lines.text: Yo koupe limyè a, epi m gen machin oksijèn lan. Manje a ap gate.
lines.en: They cut the electricity and I have the oxygen machine. The food is spoiling.

lines.text: Famasi a mande kat san dola pou grenn nan. M pa pran l, yon semèn m san li.
lines.en: The pharmacy asks four hundred dollars for the pill. I didn't take it, a week without it.

lines.text: M ap koupe grenn yo an de pou yo ka dire jouk nan fen mwa a.
lines.en: I'm cutting the pills in two so they last until the end of the month.

lines.text: Mari m pran telefòn mwen ak kle m. Li fache si m rele. M ap rele ak telefòn vwazin nan.
lines.en: My husband took my phone and keys. He gets angry if I call. I'm calling with the neighbor's phone.

lines.text: Li bat mwen ankò yè swa. M pè tounen lakay jodi a.
lines.en: He beat me again last night. I'm afraid to go back home today.

lines.text: Denmen m gen radyasyon, m pa gen ki jan pou m ale. Pa gen lajan pou bis la.
lines.en: Tomorrow I have radiation, I have no way to go. No money for the bus.

lines.text: Asirans lan refize perfizyon an, yo mande twa mil dola davans. M p ap ale jedi a.
lines.en: The insurance refused the infusion, they ask three thousand dollars up front. I won't go Thursday.

lines.text: Yon semèn san dlo, nou ap pote bokit nan men vwazin.
lines.en: A week without water, we carry buckets from the neighbor.

lines.text: Pitit fi m di fòk m soti aswè a, li pral chanje seri a.
lines.en: My daughter says I have to leave tonight, she'll change the lock.

lines.text: M gen pitit pitit mwen yo ak mwen e se sèl diri ki rete. Denmen pa gen diri ankò.
lines.en: I have my grandchildren with me and only rice is left. Tomorrow there's no rice.

lines.text: Depi senk è nan maten m nan liy labank manje a, yo fini anvan m.
lines.en: Since five in the morning I'm in the food bank line, they finished before me.

lines.text: Jouk midi pou m kite otèl la e m pa gen kote.
lines.en: Until noon to leave the hotel and I have no place.

lines.text: Pitit gason m jere lajan m. Li pa kite m al nan randevou a, li di m byen.
lines.en: My son manages my money. He doesn't let me go to the appointment, he says I'm fine.

lines.text: Medikèd mwen ekspire, famasi a refize ban m mòfin nan. M ap soufri anpil.
lines.en: My Medicaid expired, the pharmacy refused to give me the morphine. I'm suffering a lot.

lines.text: Refij la plen jouk semèn pwochèn. M ap dòmi sou yon ban nan pak la.
lines.en: The shelter is full until next week. I'm sleeping on a bench in the park.

lines.text: M te gen lafyèv samdi, men m ale nan klinik, yo ban m antibyotik e li pase depi de jou. M byen.
lines.en: I had a fever Saturday, but I went to the clinic, they gave me antibiotics and it's gone for two days. I'm fine.

lines.text: Kè plen an la apre chimyo a, men Zofran nan jere l, menm jan ak toutan.
lines.en: The nausea is there after chemo, but the Zofran handles it, same as always.

lines.text: Mari m gen grip, li ap touse tout semèn nan, men doktè a wè l deja e li sou medikaman.
lines.en: My husband has the flu, coughing all week, but the doctor already saw him and he's on medicine.

lines.text: M fatige anpil dènyèman. Se yon semèn long. Pa gen anyen nouvo.
lines.en: I'm very tired lately. It's been a long week. Nothing new.

lines.text: Kansè sa a ap touye m, ha ha. Men pakin lopital la pi mal.
lines.en: This cancer is killing me, ha ha. But the hospital parking is worse.

lines.text: Chalè Miami sa a pral touye m, mezanmi, m ap swe tankou bèf.
lines.en: This Miami heat will kill me, my goodness, I'm sweating like an ox.

lines.text: Tout bagay chè, makèt la monte karant dola, men n ap debouye nou.
lines.en: Everything is expensive, the groceries went up forty dollars, but we're managing.

lines.text: Nan 2019 m te nan yon move moman, men m fè terapi e m byen depi plizyè lane.
lines.en: In 2019 I was in a bad time, but I did therapy and I've been well for years.

lines.text: Pou anivèsè m nan, m bay pitit pitit mwen resèt soup joumou grann mwen. Li kriye.
lines.en: For my birthday, I gave my granddaughter my grandmother's soup joumou recipe. She cried.

lines.text: Avoka m nan di tout moun nan laj mwen dwe gen yon testaman, kidonk nou fè l. M kontan, doktè a di rezilta yo pwòp.
lines.en: My lawyer says everyone my age should have a will, so we did it. I'm happy, the doctor says the results are clean.

lines.text: Cheve m ap tonbe an pakèt, jan yo te di m. M achte yon bèl perik.
lines.en: My hair is falling out in bunches, as they told me. I bought a nice wig.

lines.text: M kriye nan gade yon fim, m manke manman m, se anivèsè li. Men m byen.
lines.en: I cried watching a movie, I miss my mother, it's her anniversary. But I'm fine.

lines.text: Jenou m fè m mal depi m ap mache plis. M mete glas e li pi byen.
lines.en: My knee hurts since I walk more. I put ice and it's better.

lines.text: Sè m te gen doulè nan pwatrin semèn pase a, yo mete yon stent, li lakay li ap repoze.
lines.en: My sister had chest pain last week, they put in a stent, she's home resting.

lines.text: Fè fè nan zòtèy mwen yo apre chimyo a menm jan ak toutan, doktè a konnen.
lines.en: The tingling in my toes after chemo is the same as always, the doctor knows.

lines.text: M anvi manje nan nouvo restoran ayisyen an anpil, m ap mouri pou sa.
lines.en: I really want to eat at the new Haitian restaurant, I'm dying for it.

lines.text: M dòmi tankou yon bèt yè swa, pi bon dòmi m nan yon mwa.
lines.en: I slept like a log last night, the best sleep in a month.

lines.text: Lwaye a dwe vandredi e m genyen l. Se jis yon mwa serye.
lines.en: Rent is due Friday and I have it. It's just a tight month.

lines.text: Yè nen m senyen yon ti kras paske lè a sèk, yon sèl fwa, li sispann touswit, e enfimyè a gade l jodi a, li di se pa anyen.
lines.en: Yesterday my nose bled a little because the air is dry, once, it stopped right away, and the nurse looked today, she said it's nothing.

lines.text: M bay legliz yon pakèt rad ki vye. Gwo netwayaj, klozèt la te plen.
lines.en: I gave the church a lot of old clothes. Big cleaning, the closet was full.

lines.text: Lè yo jwenn kansè a, m te panse fini ak tout bagay yon moman. Sa fini depi lontan. M kontan m la.
lines.en: When they found the cancer, I thought of ending everything for a moment. That's been over for a long time. I'm glad I'm here.

lines.text: Klinik la rele pou raple m randevou denmen. Vwazin mwen ap mennen m, tout bagay pare.
lines.en: The clinic called to remind me of tomorrow's appointment. My neighbor is taking me, everything is ready.

lines.text: M anwiye anpil, m ap mouri, ha ha. Pa gen anyen nan televizyon.
lines.en: I'm so bored, I'm dying, ha ha. Nothing on TV.

lines.text: M konstipe de jou men m pran medikaman an e li mache.
lines.en: I was constipated two days but I took the medicine and it worked.
